title: The Worm Mod
description: Dig up worms. Eat worms. Every Minecrafters dream.
body:
In 2009, a little indie game about blocks took over the internet by storm. Shortly thereafter, players made it their own-- creating mods, texture packs, adventure maps, and more. They each truly made Minecraft a unique experience catered to themselves, each stemming from one question that began to float around their minds.

"What if Minecraft had machinery?"

"What if Minecraft had magic?"

"What if Minecraft had more creatures?"

Through these simple queries, countless memories and friendships were formed. Yet, despite all this time, one question has been asked countlessly in the minds of millions, yet has not had an answer-- until now.

"What if Minecraft had worms I could eat?"




Dig blocks. Collect worms. Hoard worms. Consume worms. It's simple. It's effective. It's elegant. There is a world of worms out there for you to digest-- you best get digging.

![Steve holds a worm. He is proud. You can't help but feel proud, too.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b0b753d4faac2befcd81dabfc131d848606cfe9.png)
